name: Envirotech Systems Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1997, Envirotech Systems Ltd is an acoustic insulation company that provides customized soundproofing solutions[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
EAL specializes in acoustic engineering, offering noise measurement and control solutions for industrial and commercial applications. Operating on a B2B model, the company has completed over 2,000 projects.
Product Profile[2]  [3]  [4]
a) Acoustic Enclosure: Reduces noise from industrial machines like gas turbines, steam turbines, compressors, and CNC machines.
b) Noise Booth: Eliminates shop floor noise, offering online & offline noise testing for products.
c) Engine Test Room Acoustic: Provides controlled acoustical environments for accurate product testing.
d) Anechoic Chamber: Designed to eliminate sound reflections and block external noise.
e) Semi-Anechoic Chamber: Used for vehicle testing, absorbing sound waves while allowing controlled conditions.
f) Noise Barriers: Full-service design, delivery, and installation for noise-reducing barriers.
g) Acoustic Louvers & Doors: Allows airflow while reducing noise, commonly used in industrial plants.
h) Acoustic Doors: Fire-retardant metal doors customized to customer specifications.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 41.7%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has high debtors of 212 days.
Working capital days have increased from 110 days to 165 days
